verdicts.why: Ayo does first show up hunting Zemo at the end of TFaTWS #3, but the stage text also covers the eight hours (#4) and the Raft (#5), so moving it to #3 would spoil later episodes. It needs splitting into separate stages, not a title move.

value.text: Ayo leads the Dora Milaje against Namor's forces when he attacks Wakanda, where Namor slices the side of her Royal Talon Fighter and sends it crashing, and again on the Sea Leopard. The fighting only stops when Shuri and Namor agree to a truce.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The king of Talokan, who sends Ayo's fighter crashing.

verdicts.why: Fandom puts the Talon Fighter attack in the Birnin Zana attack, not on the Sea Leopard, and says Namor 'sliced the side of the ship'. So 'slices the side' fits the source better than 'slices through'.
Ayo stopping Okoye from leaving is cited to BPWFDS, which the wiki's reference data defines as a Wakanda Forever deleted scene. The promotion to general is in the film.
Bakuto first appears in IF107, reuniting with Colleen as her loyal sensei. She betrays him in IF110, so dropping 'She turns on him' from the S1#7 stage is right.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#10
value.text: Colleen sees Bakuto stab Danny and opens the compound gate so Danny and Davos can escape, turning against her sensei.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Bakuto's student, who betrays him to free Danny.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Colleen's old sensei, whom she betrays after he stabs Danny.

verdicts.why: The betrayal at the gate is IF110, but Bakuto sending her to be drained is IF111, so that part spoils an S1#10 stage. In IF111 she still says she believes in the Hand, so 'learns what the Hand really is' is not supported either.

Elektra kills Alexandra and claims the Hand in Defenders #6. But Bakuto first challenges her afterward, and the remaining fingers only agree to let her lead in #7, so 'Bakuto follows her' starts in #7.
Whitehall's lecture and his choosing Strucker as a student (the mentor link) are shown in AoS515 'Rise and Shine'. In S2 Strucker is only mentioned as overseas.
The gang takes Davos as shifu in IF207. BB's training under him, his falling out and his digging up the bowl for Joy are all IF208.
The force-field-around-heads scuffle in Building Q is cited to FFFS (the separate 'Fantastic Four: First Steps' tie-in), not TFFFS (the film). The new text is accurate for the film.
Wikipedia's S3 episode 10 'Karen' summary has Dex, dressed as Daredevil, killing Lantom at Clinton Church. They have no earlier relationship.
Dex goes to Clinton Church to kill Karen in episode 10. Nothing in the stage text is first in episode 11.
The Clinton Church fight between Matt and Dex is in episode 10 'Karen'. Episode 11 only covers the aftermath.

Wikipedia's Born Again S1 episode 8 summary has Dex escape prison, then arrive at the ball and shoot at Fisk. Fandom cites his 'one good deed' redemption motive to DDBA204, so 'to make up for his past' was a spoiler.
Sitwell, sent to neutralize them, instead offers Bennie a job in R&D and Claire a job as Blake's assistant. The one-shot leaves them recruited, not enemies.
Fandom has Betty and Jason reporting the Washington rescue on Midtown News afterward and thanking Spider-Man. She is not among those he saves.
Betty's interview with Dell is cited to SMNWHTMFSV (No Way Home, The More Fun Stuff Version). Dell chaperones the Europe trip in Far From Home, and fandom calls him her history teacher.

The new text is accurate: Eric guards Providence, Billy guards the Playground, and Ward kills Eric. The Koenigs' work on the LMD program only comes out in AoS412, so it spoiled an S1 stage. Their evidence is wrong on one point: fandom lists Eric as an LMD technician too.

The current text is supported: fandom says Billy did not surrender himself, so Death took Agatha and told Billy he could go. The proposal adds unsupported claims, that Rio is in 'Billy's coven' (it is Agatha's) and that she secretly came to claim him from the start.
Madani and Russo have sex in episode 5, and episode 6 reveals Russo is secretly working with Rawlins. Episode 6 is the first point where the whole stage text holds without spoiling.
In S3 episode 4 'Blindsided', Marci convinces Foggy to run for district attorney against Tower.
Fandom calls Mel de Fontaine's assistant, not a scientist. She identifies Bob as a surviving Project Sentry subject.
Bakshi is handed over to Talbot in AoS211. Talbot defending Creel, as head of the ATCU, comes in S3 'The Inside Man' (AoS312).
May having scouted Bobbi at the Academy is cited only to AoS306 'Among Us Hide...', so it spoils an S2#15 stage.
Bobbi greets Joey at the Playground in AoS301 and calls his door-sealing idea amazing in AoS310 'Maveth'. Nothing in the stage is from S3#13.
In EC101 the rain drives the girls indoors, and Taloa leaves for the store with Maya, who ends up in hospital. Taloa does not die while Bonnie and Maya are camping.
In TP213 Curtis hands the kidnapped David Schultz to Mahoney at the racetrack, and Mahoney gives Curtis a pass.
Cashman kills Blake in 'The Hateful Darkness' (DDBA207), and fandom lists him as Blake's 'Former Friend and Killer'. From that title on, enemy fits better than boss.
Fandom cites DDBA101 for Cashman as Fisk's right-hand man: he backs Fisk at debate prep, clears crowds and is with him when he wins the election.
Erik pays off Gor and takes Brianna to safety in JJ305. The father backstory is cited to JJ309, so dropping it from the S3#5 stage is right.
Wikipedia's plot has the Abomination attack Sterns, and Banner's blood gets into a cut on his forehead so he starts mutating. His becoming a villain is not shown in this film.

Najma brings the Clandestines to the wedding, and Bruno is knocked out by Saleem's chair. Najma dies in episode 5, so Bruno never protects Kamran from her. Their evidence has one error: Kamran warns Kamala at the wedding, he is not on the Clandestines' side.
At the bank the Winter Soldier attacks the scientists repairing his arm, which forces Rollins and the guards to hold him at gunpoint. The warnings come from the scientists.
Bushmaster does ambush Luke at the end of S2 episode 3. But the stage text also covers their temporary alliance (episode 12, the refinery), which would spoil if the stage moved to #3.
Bushmaster's first try at killing Mariah is the burning house in episode 7. In episode 4 he only visits her about their families' history, so 'tries to kill Mariah' does not hold from #4.
Ridley was made deputy chief at the start of S2 (LC201). After Ridenhour's death she returns to command the precinct and leads the move against Bushmaster (LC209).

When Shades finds Bushmaster in episode 3, Bushmaster is happy to pay Mariah, and they do the deal. The hostility starts with his visit in episode 4 and the severed heads in episode 5, so they are not enemies from #3.
Wikipedia's episode 9 summary has Bushmaster escape police transport with a grenade, then find Johnson and force her to heal him. That comes before the episode 12 alliance.
Peggy learns of Chadwick's affair in S2 episode 1. But 'agrees to Whitney Frost's plan to have her killed' is episode 3, so the move would spoil it.
Hunt attacks Peggy in episode 3, but the stage text includes his blackmail and Whitney absorbing him, which are episode 4. On an S2#3 stage that would be a spoiler.

In episode 3 Masters only introduces Thompson to Chadwick at the Arena Club. Masters's own role in the Council is not clearly shown until later episodes, so 'fellow members of the Council of Nine' is not clearly supported from #3.
They appear as husband and wife covering up the murder in episode 1. But 'real brains' is episode 2 and 'She kills him' is episode 6, so moving the stage to #1 would spoil both.
Cal joins Whitehall in episode 5. His revenge plan comes out in episode 8, when he finds his wife's remains and vows vengeance while posing as an ally, so the stage text is not true from #5.

Simmons restarts Cal's heart with adrenaline, which completes the formula. He then transforms, breaks out of the pod and shrugs off the I.C.E.R.s (AoS221). The current text has the order and the I.C.E.R. effect wrong.
The Triplett operation is AoS208. But the stage text goes on to the medical pod attack in AoS221, which would spoil on an S2#8 stage.
May faces Cal at Manitowoc in episode 13. But the handover into May's custody in the stage text is AoS220, so moving the stage to #13 would spoil it.
